dialogues.jp: さて、今日も昼飯を調達に行くか。
dialogues.en: Time to secure today's afternoon rations.
dialogues.text: Time to secure today's afternoon rations.

dialogues.jp: 何食おう。
dialogues.en: What should I eat?
dialogues.text: What should I eat?

dialogues.jp: やはり狙うは焼きそばパンだろう。
dialogues.en: If they're available, I'd aim for the yakisoba bread.
dialogues.text: If they're available, I'd aim for the yakisoba bread.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、競争率が激しかったら、もう売れてる
かもしれないな。
dialogues.en:
But the competition is fierce... it might be sold out by now
already.
dialogues.text:
But the competition is fierce... it might be sold out by now
already.

dialogues.jp: その時はコロッケパンという手も……。
dialogues.en: I guess I'd take a croquette bread if that happens...
dialogues.text: I guess I'd take a croquette bread if that happens...

dialogues.jp: ま、とりあえず、行ってみるか。
dialogues.en: In any case, better go now.
dialogues.text: In any case, better go now.

dialogues.jp: ん？　あれは……。
dialogues.en: Mm? That's...
dialogues.text: Mm? That's...

dialogues.jp: 反対側から、制服姿の環に出会う。
dialogues.en: Turning around, I bumped into Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Turning around, I bumped into Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日のお昼は、巫女服は着ないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You're not wearing your miko dress this afternoon?"
dialogues.text: "You're not wearing your miko dress this afternoon?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「別にいつもいつも、巫女装束って訳じゃない
　んですよ」
dialogues.en: "It isn't quite something I wear at all times."
dialogues.text: "It isn't quite something I wear at all times."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そっか、まあそうだな」
dialogues.en: "Hah, I guess."
dialogues.text: "Hah, I guess."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとした冗談だったんだが、真面目に返す
環ってば、なんだかかわいい。
dialogues.en: I was mostly joking, but her serious reply was somehow cute.
dialogues.text: I was mostly joking, but her serious reply was somehow cute.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの姿になる時は、特別ですから……」
dialogues.en: "That costume is only for special circumstances..."
dialogues.text: "That costume is only for special circumstances..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「特別？」
dialogues.en: "Special circumstances?"
dialogues.text: "Special circumstances?"

dialogues.jp: 環はそれだけしか言わない。
dialogues.en: Tamaki wouldn't say any more than that.
dialogues.text: Tamaki wouldn't say any more than that.

dialogues.jp: まあ、言いたくないなら別にいいだろう。
dialogues.en: Well, if she wants to keep it private, I can't say anything.
dialogues.text: Well, if she wants to keep it private, I can't say anything.

dialogues.jp: こっちも無理に聞くようなことじゃない。
dialogues.en: I don't want to force anything out of her either.
dialogues.text: I don't want to force anything out of her either.

dialogues.jp:
「この辺をうろついているってことは、今日の
　お昼は購買か？」
dialogues.en:
"If you were hanging around here, I guess you had to buy
lunch today?"
dialogues.text:
"If you were hanging around here, I guess you had to buy
lunch today?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。今日はお弁当を忘れてしまったので、
　早く行かなければ無くなってしまうと思って」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. As I had forgotten my lunchbox today, I thought that
if I didn't hurry, there would be nothing left."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. As I had forgotten my lunchbox today, I thought that
if I didn't hurry, there would be nothing left."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。で、何を買ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Right. What did you buy?"
dialogues.text: "Right. What did you buy?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これです」
dialogues.en: "This."
dialogues.text: "This."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おお……それは！」
dialogues.en: "Ohh... that's!"
dialogues.text: "Ohh... that's!"

dialogues.jp:
環の手に握られていたのは、男子たちが競って
奪い合う、焼きそばパンだった。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki held in her hands, the prized possession that men
would come to blows for; yakisoba bread.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki held in her hands, the prized possession that men
would come to blows for; yakisoba bread.

dialogues.jp: 「それ、まだ残ってた？」
dialogues.en: "Is there any more left?"
dialogues.text: "Is there any more left?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は祈るような気持ちで尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Praying for a positive response, I enquired.
dialogues.text: Praying for a positive response, I enquired.

dialogues.jp: 環は一瞬、考え込む仕草をする。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's expression turned to one of ponderance.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's expression turned to one of ponderance.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……。そういえばわたくしが最後だった
　かも」
dialogues.en: "I don't believe so... the one I have, was the last."
dialogues.text: "I don't believe so... the one I have, was the last."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり……」
dialogues.en: "Of course..."
dialogues.text: "Of course..."

dialogues.jp: そうだよな。
dialogues.en: Naturally.
dialogues.text: Naturally.

dialogues.jp: 「コロッケパンとかはあった？」
dialogues.en: "What about croquette bread?"
dialogues.text: "What about croquette bread?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いえ……確か、わたくしが帰るときには皆さ
　んが殺到されていたので……多分……」
dialogues.en:
"Well... at the time I left, there was a sudden flood for
bread at the store, so..."
dialogues.text:
"Well... at the time I left, there was a sudden flood for
bread at the store, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp: スタートダッシュの遅れが響いたか。
dialogues.en: I should've gotten there earlier.
dialogues.text: I should've gotten there earlier.

dialogues.jp: 俺、もしかして昼飯抜き？
dialogues.en: Looks like I'd have to skip lunch today.
dialogues.text: Looks like I'd have to skip lunch today.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これって人気のある商品なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is this bread particularly popular?"
dialogues.text: "Is this bread particularly popular?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の落ち込み具合で察したのか、環が尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Seeing my crestfallen state, Tamaki started to speak.
dialogues.text: Seeing my crestfallen state, Tamaki started to speak.

dialogues.jp:
「ああ、数が少ないらしくてな。その上、美味
　いから、いつも取り合いになっているらしい」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, there aren't many in stock every day. On top of that,
it's delicious, so there's always a scramble for them."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, there aren't many in stock every day. On top of that,
it's delicious, so there's always a scramble for them."

dialogues.jp: 一週間に運がよくて２回しか食べられない。
dialogues.en:
Even with the luck of the devil himself, you'd be
hard-pressed to eat it more than once a week.
dialogues.text:
Even with the luck of the devil himself, you'd be
hard-pressed to eat it more than once a week.

dialogues.jp: 伝説の焼きそばパン……。
dialogues.en: The legendary yakisoba bread...
dialogues.text: The legendary yakisoba bread...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様も、これがお好きなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "And, you like this type of bread?"
dialogues.text: "And, you like this type of bread?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そりゃまあ……」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Well, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Well, yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、これ差し上げます」
dialogues.en: "In that case, please accept this."
dialogues.text: "In that case, please accept this."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　いいの？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Really?"

dialogues.jp:
環の声が一瞬、曇り空から降りてきた天使の梯
子のように思える。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's envisage transformed to that of an angel,
descending from the cloudy sky.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's envisage transformed to that of an angel,
descending from the cloudy sky.

dialogues.jp: そうじゃなければ、地獄に垂らされた蜘蛛の糸。
dialogues.en:
Or if not that, a spider hanging from it's web in the depths
of hell.
dialogues.text:
Or if not that, a spider hanging from it's web in the depths
of hell.

dialogues.jp: この際、もう、何でもいい。
dialogues.en: Whichever.
dialogues.text: Whichever.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、これをもらってしまったら、環の分が
なくなってしまう。
dialogues.en: But, if I take this, what about Tamaki?
dialogues.text: But, if I take this, what about Tamaki?

dialogues.jp: 「でも、環の分が無くなるよな」
dialogues.en: "But you woun't have anything left..."
dialogues.text: "But you woun't have anything left..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いいんです。わたくしにはまだ、メロンパン
　がありますから」
dialogues.en: "It's fine. I still have a packet of melon bread, as well."
dialogues.text: "It's fine. I still have a packet of melon bread, as well."

dialogues.jp:
環はそう言って、メロンパンを取り出して微笑
む。
dialogues.en: She showed me her other packet, smiling.
dialogues.text: She showed me her other packet, smiling.

dialogues.jp: そんな仕草が、何か可愛いと感じた。
dialogues.en: Those actions and movements... how cute.
dialogues.text: Those actions and movements... how cute.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Here, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Here, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……。悪いな」
dialogues.en: "Alright... sorry, and thanks."
dialogues.text: "Alright... sorry, and thanks."

dialogues.jp: 今日は、尻尾を振った犬にでも何にでもなるぞ。
dialogues.en: Today, I am a dog with it's tail up.
dialogues.text: Today, I am a dog with it's tail up.

dialogues.jp: 交換条件に突拍子もないことを言われようとも、
dialogues.en: People may say things about it being an unfair trade,
dialogues.text: People may say things about it being an unfair trade,

dialogues.jp: 今日は、何でも、言うこと聞こうじゃないか。
dialogues.en: But I have no ears for them today.
dialogues.text: But I have no ears for them today.

dialogues.jp:
と、身構えていたのだが、返ってきた言葉はと
ても淡白だった。
dialogues.en:
The words I heard immediately after, didn't tally too well
with my stance.
dialogues.text:
The words I heard immediately after, didn't tally too well
with my stance.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、私は急ぎますので」
dialogues.en: "Then, I'd be leaving now."
dialogues.text: "Then, I'd be leaving now."

dialogues.jp:
環は俺に焼きそばパンを渡し、さっさと教室の
方へと帰っていく。
dialogues.en:
As soon as she handed the yakisoba bread to me, she quickly
returned to the classroom.
dialogues.text:
As soon as she handed the yakisoba bread to me, she quickly
returned to the classroom.

dialogues.jp: あっさりと……。
dialogues.en: So hurriedly...
dialogues.text: So hurriedly...

dialogues.jp: （そんなに、あっさり帰らなくても……）
dialogues.en: "(You don't have to go so fast...)"
dialogues.text: "(You don't have to go so fast...)"

dialogues.jp:
せっかくなんだから、どこかで一緒にメシでも
食べようかと思ったけれど、声をかけるヒマも
なかったな。
dialogues.en:
After all that, I was going to ask to eat together, but I
couldn't call her out before she left.
dialogues.text:
After all that, I was going to ask to eat together, but I
couldn't call her out before she left.

dialogues.jp:
積極的なんだか、消極的なんだか……。まあ、
少なくとも、環が優しいことだけは確かだ。
dialogues.en:
Well, for better or for worse... there's no doubt that she's
a kind person.
dialogues.text:
Well, for better or for worse... there's no doubt that she's
a kind person.

dialogues.jp: ◆伝説の焼きそばパン◆
dialogues.en: ◆Legendary Yakisoba Bread?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Legendary Yakisoba Bread?◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、購買へパンを買いに行こうとすると、
途中で環に会う。
dialogues.en: On my way to buy bread, I bumped into Tamaki.
dialogues.text: On my way to buy bread, I bumped into Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
環に焼きそばパンが売れてしまったかどうか聞
くと、売り切れていたらしい。
dialogues.en:
She was coming back from buying bread herself. According to
her, it's probably all sold out by now.
dialogues.text:
She was coming back from buying bread herself. According to
her, it's probably all sold out by now.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、随分とがっかりしてしまったが、なんと
環は自分の分をくれると言う。それも無条件で。
dialogues.en:
Seeing my crestfallen state, Tamaki insisted on giving me
part of hers, no strings attached.
dialogues.text:
Seeing my crestfallen state, Tamaki insisted on giving me
part of hers, no strings attached.

dialogues.jp:
変なヤツだと思ってたけど、案外優しいところ
もあるんだな。
dialogues.en: She's a little weird, but she's definitely a kind person.
dialogues.text: She's a little weird, but she's definitely a kind person.
